svg.text: DIMENSIONED MECHANICAL DRAWINGS · DERIVED FROM pi-stack-v0.7.scad
5× SKIRT NOTCH 6.00 WIDE @ 9.00 PITCH (FOR BASE VENTS)
4 ARMS ON 34.84° DIAGONALS: ROOT Ø16.00 @ r46.00,
CUT WAIST 12.00 WIDE @ r64.00, TIP Ø20.00 @ r70.00 (SHEET 5)
1. The light chain rectangle is the case datum; every
position here is measured from it.
2. Dashed circles lie on the BASE's underside, above the
plate floor: remove the four plate bolts to reach them.
3. The Pi's four M2.5 screws go up from underneath through
the counterbores; each takes a nut above the PCB.
4. The six M3 × 14 case screws go up through the BASE's
rim into the MID. Their heads are covered by the plate.
5. Plate bolts are M3 × 6 into blind Ø2.75 ×
6. Plate thickness 4.00; counterbores are in the OUTER face.
7. Arm waist is cut: two Ø8.00 cuts 10.00 off each
arm axis at r 64.00 leave a 12.00 strap seat.
Plate outline and arms, plate bolts, Pi counterbores, six rim bores
